# ferentin_otel_sink_provider (Data Source)

Look up an OTEL sink provider in the global catalog by slug. Read-only.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ferentin_otel_sink_provider" "otlp" {
  slug = "otlp"
}

output "otlp_name" {
  value = data.ferentin_otel_sink_provider.otlp.display_name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `slug` (String) Catalog slug (`datadog`, `honeycomb`, `otlp`, …).

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Catalog description.
- `display_name` (String) Display name.
- `id` (String) Same as `slug`.
- `name` (String) Catalog name.
